fields.System.Title: Import with a summary
fields.System.Description: As an admin, I want a summary when the import ends, so that I know what happened to every row.
fields.Microsoft.VSTS.Common.AcceptanceCriteria:
1. Given a row whose email matches an existing customer, then the existing customer is updated with the row's values.
  2. The summary shows the number of rows imported, updated and rejected.
